payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the proposed method using reinforcement learning (RL) improves task success rate and total task reward compared to supervised training methods.

claims.text: The proposed method leads to promising improvements on task success rate and total task reward compared to supervised training methods.
The combination of supervised learning and deep reinforcement learning improves system robustness and dialog success rate over purely supervised methods.
The iterative optimization of the dialog agent and user simulator with deep RL enhances performance beyond what is achievable with supervised training alone.
